integrity: The closed-form covariance, the short-time Gaussian partial-transpose expansion and asymptotic spectral gap are derived explicitly. Numerical checks are reproducibility checks, not proofs for the infinite-dimensional oscillator and not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Analytic theorem requires exact resonance, zero-temperature charger-only linear Lindblad loss, strictly positive exchange coupling, subthreshold parametric pump, and vacuum initialization for the short-time entanglement coefficient.
Stationary convergence also applies to Gaussian inputs with finite second moments; no uniqueness of entanglement death time is claimed.
The motivating source already supplies the stationary battery energy and single-mode ergotropy. Neither is a novelty claim.
The original source's separately hosted supplementary covariance calculations could not be examined comprehensively; exact equivalent-priority risk remains.
title: Universal transient entanglement and exact stationary decorrelation in a resonantly driven Gaussian quantum battery
